estimate.basis: About 6M generator input / 0.6M output tokens plus 80 judgments up to 4K input / 1600 output each; uncertainty allowance for long histories, extra extraction and failures.

budget.guard: Every request reserves full conservative bound atomically before dispatch; successful verified receipts settle at 4x usage, errors/unknown retain bounds. Reject dispatch above cumulative cap. No automatic retry or restart.
budget.stop: Stop only these run workers if accounting fails or cap blocks dispatch; preserve saved answers and artifacts. No new paid compute provisioned.

retry_policy: At most one unchanged missing-judge retry after diagnosis; no regeneration or replacement of completed judgments; no automatic HTTP retries.
data_policy: Eight new authored test cases frozen before output inspection; four natural position-change cases and four dense multi-branch cases. No development tuning on outcomes.
